title: Torus amplitude of a quasi-coherent complex on a space descends along fpqc covers of the base
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For an fpqc covering {Y_i -> Y} of algebraic spaces over S, a map f : X -> Y, base changes X_i, and E in D_QCoh(O_X), the property that E has tor amplitude in [a, b] as an object of D(f^{-1}O_Y) is equivalent to all derived pullbacks L(g'_i)^*E having tor amplitude in [a, b] over D(f_i^{-1}O_{Y_i}); the same holds with tor amplitude replaced by locally finite tor dimension. The retained proof is complete: pullback preserves the amplitude bound (Derived Categories of Spaces, lemma-tor-independence-and-tor-amplitude), tor independence of Y_i and X over Y is free from flatness, tor dimension is computed on geometric stalks (Cohomology on Sites, lemma-tor-amplitude-stalk; exactness of stalk functors), the base-change comparison of derived fibres via More on Algebra, lemma-base-change-comparison identifies the stalk of the pullback with a derived base change over O_{Y,y}, and flat descent of tor amplitude (More on Algebra, lemma-flat-descent-tor-amplitude) closes (1); the locally finite variant is an elementary topological argument. Retained author proof at lines 13037-13075.
